Contineo API Spec (llms.txt)

Base URL: /api
Auth: Query parameters (`usn`, `dob`, optional `course`, optional `portal`)
Format: JSON responses, error format `{"error": "message"}`
Date Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`

Endpoints:
- GET /health
  Status: 200 OK
  Response: {"status": "ok", "time": "<ISO8601>"}

- GET /api/dashboard?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&portal={even|odd}
  Returns: Student profile, courses list, attendance summary, active portal.

- GET /api/attendance?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&course={courseCode}&portal={even|odd}
  Returns: Course attendance statistics and class log records.

- GET /api/cie?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&course={courseCode}&portal={even|odd}
  Returns: Internal assessments, component marks, final CIE score.

- GET /api/exam-history?usn={usn}&dob={dob}&portal={even|odd}
  Returns: Semester-wise results, grades, SGPA, credits, CGPA.
